scope.geography: Johor Bahru + Singapore CIQ comparison, A/B/C three-zone proposal; exact QGIS areas not yet verified
scope.historic_limit: Old 128 ODs were all inland cross_border_route=False; never reclassify as cross-border
scope.primary_functional_unit: one frozen synthetic consignment delivered to destination by deadline
secondary_units: per vehicle-day and per ton-km where denominators documented
scope.period: historical 2026-05 through 2026-09; exact dates remain to freeze with one demand population
scope.analysis_kind: counterfactual conditional modeling, no observed shipment or approved UAV mission claim

task_constraints: Same immutable task IDs, locations, mass, timestamps and deadline for M0 M1 M2
One frozen sample only: never add 918000 resampled Stage2 to 29842 Stage6
UNREACHABLE, WEATHER_BLOCKED, NOT_AUTHORIZED and MISSING_INPUT retained as distinct outcomes
All order status and fallback outputs retained; no success-only denominator
Do not change synthetic-demand geography unless explicitly remapped and versioned
Cross-border class defined by actual country pair; no assumptions from zone names

M0.definition: road-only petrol car OR diesel van (distinct paired sensitivity profiles)
M0.asset_boundary: same depot/reposition/return/vehicle capacity and handling as corresponding mixed modes

M1.definition: fixed-site feeder with consolidation and UAV segment as candidate scenario
M1.asset_boundary: road feeder, terminal and transfer, UAV outbound and return, charging, fallback, queuing and reserve

M2.definition: vehicle-drone coordinated rendezvous with physical vehicle and drone time synchronization
M2.asset_boundary: shared vehicle kilometers counted once; moving drone launch, pickup recovery, wait, service and fallback

weather_join: proposed actual UAV takeoff+arrival+return hour or finer source resolution, flag uncertainty for longer hourly data
road_join: directed OSM/model path and source-hour traffic proxy; no invented reverse, CIQ customs modeled separately when crossing

accounting.primary: fuel tank-to-wheel CO2 plus location-based charging electricity CO2 using gas-consistent emission factors; primary CO2e withheld until harmonized full GHG inputs
accounting.secondary: fossil fuel upstream and embodied emissions excluded from operational totals; may be separate explicitly labeled sensitivity
accounting.petrol_diesel_CO2_formula: road_fuel_L = route_km * validated_L_per_100km/100 + validated_disjoint_idle_L; CO2_kg = road_fuel_L * density_kg_per_L * NCV_MJ_per_kg/1e6 * EF_kgCO2_per_TJ
accounting.grid_CO2_formula: sum_by_charging_country(wall_kWh * national_grid_kgCO2_per_kWh); do not use 0.740 MY kgCO2e and 0.402 SG kgCO2 as one CO2e ledger
accounting.mission_electricity: battery discharge kWh, charging loss, idle loads and battery swap logistics separately; no battery nominal/max range quotient
no_double_count: no grid factor on combusted fuel
no second count of shared M2 road movement
no repeated shared linehaul trip per parcel
no additional turnaround if part of route energy already

run_policy.regulatory_status: candidate_only; no legal cross-border flight claims

notes: This freezes definitions and source hierarchy, NOT numerical mission energy, fuel economy, cost, or permit assumptions.
